```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
# Assumes combined_all, Chik_total from 01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd
# state_region_lookup comes from 00_setup.R directly -- Points 1-4
# below need nothing beyond 01 + 00.
# Point 5 (optional draft correlation check) additionally needs
# mun_data_recent with irr and prop_65plus from 07_priority_metric_fig2.Rmd.
# It is skipped automatically if those objects are unavailable.
```

This file uses the 18-59 age window specified in the current revision framework as a
programmatic eligibility stratum. It answers the descriptive question: what share of
Brazil's observed chikungunya deaths occurred outside that age window?

This file does not independently establish regulatory eligibility and should not be used
as a source for current vaccine-label language; manuscript wording should cite the
relevant regulatory/programmatic source directly.

This is a **descriptive stratification of observed deaths by
revision-defined age bands** -- not an estimate of preventable deaths,
which would require efficacy and coverage assumptions.

## Age-band classification

```{r age-band-classification}
chik_confirmed <- combined_all %>%
  filter(virus == "Chikungunya", CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)) %>%
  mutate(DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI)) %>%
  filter(DT_SIN_PRI >= as.Date("2016-01-01"), DT_SIN_PRI <= as.Date("2025-12-31"))

stopifnot(
  nrow(chik_confirmed) == nrow(Chik_total),
  min(chik_confirmed$DT_SIN_PRI, na.rm = TRUE) >= as.Date("2016-01-01"),
  max(chik_confirmed$DT_SIN_PRI, na.rm = TRUE) <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
)

age_band <- function(age_years) {
  case_when(
    is.na(age_years)        ~ NA_character_,
    age_years < 18           ~ "under 18 (outside 18-59 window)",
    age_years >= 18 & age_years < 60 ~ "18-59 (eligibility window)",
    age_years >= 60           ~ "60+ (outside 18-59 window)"
  )
}

chik_confirmed <- chik_confirmed %>%
  mutate(
    eligibility_band = age_band(age_years),
    eligibility_band = factor(
      eligibility_band,
      levels = c("under 18 (outside 18-59 window)", "18-59 (eligibility window)", "60+ (outside 18-59 window)")
    ),
    year = as.integer(format(as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y"))
  )

n_missing_age <- sum(is.na(chik_confirmed$eligibility_band))
cat("Confirmed cases with missing/unusable age (excluded from the tabulations below):", n_missing_age, "\n")
```

## Point 1: Deaths by eligibility band, 2016-2025

```{r deaths-by-band}
deaths_by_band <- chik_confirmed %>%
  filter(case_status == "Death", !is.na(eligibility_band)) %>%
  count(eligibility_band, name = "deaths") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * deaths / sum(deaths), 1))

print(deaths_by_band)

# The headline sentence this section is meant to produce:
pct_outside_18_59 <- deaths_by_band %>%
  filter(eligibility_band != "18-59 (eligibility window)") %>%
  summarise(pct = sum(pct)) %>% pull(pct)

cat(sprintf(
  "\n%.1f%% of chikungunya deaths occurred in people outside the 18-59 eligibility window used in this revision.\n",
  pct_outside_18_59
))
```

## Point 2: Hospitalizations by eligibility band (+ YLL if computable)

```{r hosp-by-band}
chik_confirmed <- chik_confirmed %>%
  mutate(HOSPITALIZ = as.character(HOSPITALIZ))

hosp_by_band <- chik_confirmed %>%
  filter(HOSPITALIZ == "1", !is.na(eligibility_band)) %>%
  count(eligibility_band, name = "hospitalizations") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * hospitalizations / sum(hospitalizations), 1))

print(hosp_by_band)
```

**Years of life lost:** not computed here. YLL needs a standard life
table (life expectancy at age of death) to convert each death into a
years-lost figure -- there is no life-table object anywhere in this
pipeline yet. If you want this, the cleanest source is IBGE's national
life tables (Tabua de Mortalidade) by single year of age; Cerqueira-Silva
et al. (already ref 14, average YLL 16.0, highest among Black
participants at 22.0) is the existing citable benchmark to compare
against once you have it. Flagging as not computable with current data
rather than approximating it.

## Point 3: By macro-region, and separately for the 2024-25 wave

```{r by-region-and-wave}
chik_confirmed_region <- chik_confirmed %>%
  mutate(code_state = substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 2)) %>%
  left_join(state_region_lookup, by = "code_state")

deaths_by_band_region <- chik_confirmed_region %>%
  filter(case_status == "Death", !is.na(eligibility_band), !is.na(region)) %>%
  count(region, eligibility_band, name = "deaths") %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * deaths / sum(deaths), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(deaths_by_band_region)

deaths_by_band_2425 <- chik_confirmed %>%
  filter(case_status == "Death", !is.na(eligibility_band), year %in% c(2024, 2025)) %>%
  count(eligibility_band, name = "deaths") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * deaths / sum(deaths), 1))

cat("\n2024-25 wave only:\n")
print(deaths_by_band_2425)
```

## Point 4: Additional exclusion from comorbidity contraindications

A secondary descriptive check examines recorded chronic-condition fields. Because
SINAN comorbidity fields are incomplete and do not by themselves establish regulatory
contraindication, these variables are treated only as recorded comorbidity flags, not as
a definitive eligibility determination. No comorbidity field is used to define the
primary age-based split.

```{r comorbidity-field-check}
# Scan Chik_total for column names that might carry comorbidity/chronic
# condition flags. SINAN's chikungunya notification form field names
# vary by version -- inspect what actually exists rather than guessing.
candidate_cols <- names(Chik_total)[
  grepl("DOENC|COMORB|CRONIC|DIABE|HIPERT|CARDIO|RENAL|IMUNO", names(Chik_total), ignore.case = TRUE)
]

if (length(candidate_cols) == 0) {
  cat("No comorbidity-like columns found in Chik_total by name pattern.\n")
  cat("Full column list for manual inspection:\n")
  print(names(Chik_total))
} else {
  cat("Candidate comorbidity columns found:\n")
  print(candidate_cols)

  # Check the actual value coding before assuming anything (SINAN
  # commonly uses 1=Yes/2=No/9=Unknown, but confirm rather than guess).
  cat("\nValue distributions for each candidate column:\n")
  for (col in candidate_cols) {
    cat("\n", col, ":\n")
    print(table(Chik_total[[col]], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
}
```

## Point 4 continued: the "doubly disjoint" tabulation

Of the 5 candidate columns, only three are clean enough to use: `DIABETES`,
`RENAL`, `HIPERTENSA` -- all standard 1=Yes/2=No coding, ~85% complete.
`DOENCA_TRA` (93.6% missing) and `IMUNOH_N` (99.98% missing, and coded
2/3/4 rather than the expected 1/2/9) are excluded from the primary
calculation as too sparse/uncertain to trust.

```{r step1-point4-doubly-disjoint}
chik_confirmed <- chik_confirmed %>%
  mutate(
    has_diabetes = case_when(DIABETES == "1" ~ TRUE, DIABETES == "2" ~ FALSE, TRUE ~ NA),
    has_renal    = case_when(RENAL == "1" ~ TRUE, RENAL == "2" ~ FALSE, TRUE ~ NA),
    has_hiperten = case_when(HIPERTENSA == "1" ~ TRUE, HIPERTENSA == "2" ~ FALSE, TRUE ~ NA),
    n_comorbidity_recorded = rowSums(!is.na(cbind(has_diabetes, has_renal, has_hiperten))),
    n_conditions_raw = rowSums(cbind(has_diabetes, has_renal, has_hiperten), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_conditions = if_else(n_comorbidity_recorded == 0L, NA_integer_, as.integer(n_conditions_raw)),
    any_condition = if_else(n_comorbidity_recorded == 0L, NA, n_conditions >= 1),
    multi_condition = if_else(n_comorbidity_recorded == 0L, NA, n_conditions >= 2)
  )

cat("=== Among the 60+ (outside 18-59 window) band: comorbidity flags ===\n")
comorbidity_60plus <- chik_confirmed %>%
  filter(eligibility_band == "60+ (outside 18-59 window)")

cat("Total confirmed cases, 60+ band:", nrow(comorbidity_60plus), "\n")
cat("  Missing all three comorbidity fields:",
    sum(is.na(comorbidity_60plus$DIABETES) & is.na(comorbidity_60plus$RENAL) & is.na(comorbidity_60plus$HIPERTENSA)), "\n")
cat("  With at least one flagged condition:", sum(comorbidity_60plus$any_condition, na.rm = TRUE),
    sprintf("(%.1f%% of those with data)",
            100 * sum(comorbidity_60plus$any_condition, na.rm = TRUE) /
              sum(!is.na(comorbidity_60plus$DIABETES) | !is.na(comorbidity_60plus$RENAL) | !is.na(comorbidity_60plus$HIPERTENSA))), "\n")
cat("  With more than one recorded flagged condition:",
    sum(comorbidity_60plus$multi_condition, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\n=== Deaths in the 60+ band: recorded comorbidity overlap ===\n")
deaths_60plus_doubly_excluded <- chik_confirmed %>%
  filter(eligibility_band == "60+ (outside 18-59 window)", case_status == "Death")

cat("Deaths in 60+ band:", nrow(deaths_60plus_doubly_excluded), "\n")
known_death_comorb <- sum(deaths_60plus_doubly_excluded$n_comorbidity_recorded > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("  Deaths with >=1 of the three comorbidity fields recorded:", known_death_comorb, "\n")
cat("  Of those with comorbidity data, >=1 flagged chronic condition:",
    sum(deaths_60plus_doubly_excluded$any_condition %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)", ifelse(known_death_comorb > 0,
      100 * sum(deaths_60plus_doubly_excluded$any_condition %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) / known_death_comorb, NA_real_)), "\n")
cat("  Of those with comorbidity data, >1 flagged chronic condition:",
    sum(deaths_60plus_doubly_excluded$multi_condition %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)", ifelse(known_death_comorb > 0,
      100 * sum(deaths_60plus_doubly_excluded$multi_condition %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) / known_death_comorb, NA_real_)), "\n")

```

## Downstream interpretation

The outputs above quantify how observed cases, hospitalizations, and deaths are
distributed across the age bands used by the revision framework. They are descriptive
and should not be interpreted as estimates of vaccine-preventable events.

Formal transmission-severity prioritization is handled downstream in
`13_expected_burden_metric_FINAL_2016_2025.Rmd`, where transmission intensity and
age-weighted severity vulnerability are defined explicitly and kept separate from this
eligibility split.
